taj_mahal.name: Taj Mahal
taj_mahal.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Seven Wonders of the World, an ivory-white marble mausoleum built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan for Mumtaz Mahal.
taj_mahal.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise or sunset for magical lighting

agra_fort.name: Agra Fort
agra_fort.description: UNESCO World Heritage 16th-century red sandstone fortress that served as the imperial seat and primary residence of the Mughal dynasty until 1638.
agra_fort.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours when temperatures are cool

fatehpur_sikri.name: Fatehpur Sikri
fatehpur_sikri.description: UNESCO World Heritage historic fortified capital founded by Emperor Akbar in 1571, famed for Buland Darwaza and Salim Chishti's marble tomb.

mehtab_bagh.name: Mehtab Bagh (Moonlight Garden)
mehtab_bagh.description: Lush Charbagh complex located directly opposite the Taj Mahal across the Yamuna River, famous for unparalleled unobstructed sunset reflections of the monument.

tomb_of_itimad_ud_daulah.name: Tomb of I'timad-ud-Daulah (Baby Taj)
tomb_of_itimad_ud_daulah.description: Often called the 'Jewel Box' or 'Baby Taj', this exquisite marble mausoleum built by Empress Nur Jahan pioneered pietra dura inlay work in India.
tomb_of_itimad_ud_daulah.best_time_to_visit: Morning light to appreciate lattice screens

akbar_tomb_sikandra.name: Akbar's Tomb, Sikandra
akbar_tomb_sikandra.description: Magnificent four-tiered red sandstone and white marble mausoleum of Emperor Akbar, set amidst serene gardens frequented by blackbucks and peacocks.
akbar_tomb_sikandra.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon to stroll through the lush grounds

mariam_tomb.name: Mariam's Tomb
mariam_tomb.description: Mausoleum of Mariam-uz-Zamani (commonly known as Jodha Bai), Empress of Emperor Akbar and mother of Jahangir, featuring unique baradari pavilions.

chini_ka_rauza.name: Chini Ka Rauza
chini_ka_rauza.description: Funerary monument dedicated to Mughal poet-scholar Afzal Khan Shirazi, celebrated for its exquisite Persian porcelain-style glazed tile ornamentation.

jama_masjid_agra.name: Jama Masjid, Agra
jama_masjid_agra.description: Monumental 17th-century congregational mosque built by Mughal princess Jahanara Begum opposite Agra Fort, with distinctive zigzag patterned domes.
jama_masjid_agra.best_time_to_visit: Morning or late afternoon (outside prayer times)

moti_masjid_agra.name: Moti Masjid (Pearl Mosque)
moti_masjid_agra.description: Luminous pure white marble royal sanctuary built by Shah Jahan inside the Agra Fort complex, renowned for its flawless pearlescent radiance.

guru_ka_taal.name: Guru Ka Taal Gurudwara
guru_ka_taal.description: Revered historic Sikh pilgrimage site marking the spot where Ninth Guru, Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, voluntarily offered his arrest to Emperor Aurangzeb.
guru_ka_taal.best_time_to_visit: Early morning or during evening langar

mankameshwar_temple.name: Mankameshwar Temple
mankameshwar_temple.description: Ancient Shiva temple said to have been founded by Lord Shiva himself in Dwapara Yuga; one of the four corner guardian shrines protecting Agra.

balkeshwar_temple.name: Balkeshwar Mahadev Temple
balkeshwar_temple.description: One of the four ancient protective corner Mahadev shrines of Agra, situated on the scenic ghats of river Yamuna with lush riverside environs.

rajeshwar_temple.name: Rajeshwar Mahadev Temple
rajeshwar_temple.description: Venerated corner Shiva temple located in Rajpur Chungi, consecrated over eight centuries ago and renowned for its miraculous stone Shivalinga.

kailash_temple_agra.name: Kailash Mahadev Temple
kailash_temple_agra.description: Ancient holy Shiva shrine on the banks of Yamuna near Sikandra where Lord Rama and Parashurama are revered to have offered prayers; hosts the historic Kailash Mela.

prithvinath_temple.name: Prithvinath Temple
prithvinath_temple.description: Historic Shiva temple in Shahganj founded by Rajput King Prithviraj Chauhan, serving as the fourth sacred corner deity guarding the city.

rawatpara_petha_market.name: Rawatpara Petha & Spice Market
rawatpara_petha_market.description: Historic centuries-old marketplace located near Agra Fort and Mankameshwar Temple, world-famous as the origin and hub of authentic Agra Petha sweets.

sadar_bazaar_agra.name: Sadar Bazaar
sadar_bazaar_agra.description: Agra's premier lifestyle shopping promenade in Cantonment, famed for leather accessories, marble inlay souvenirs, garment boutiques, and delicious Chaat Gali street delicacies.

kinari_bazaar.name: Kinari Bazaar
kinari_bazaar.description: Intricate maze of historic lanes behind Jama Masjid teeming with traditional zari-zardozi embroideries, bridal trimmings, marble handicrafts, and silverware.

soor_sarovar_bird_sanctuary.name: Soor Sarovar Bird Sanctuary (Keetham Lake)
soor_sarovar_bird_sanctuary.description: Designated Ramsar wetland bird sanctuary and tranquil lake hosting over 165 species of migratory and resident aquatic birds named after poet Soordas.
soor_sarovar_bird_sanctuary.best_time_to_visit: Early morning during winter months (Nov - Feb)

wildlife_sos_elephant_centre.name: Wildlife SOS Elephant Conservation Centre
wildlife_sos_elephant_centre.description: Pioneering ethical wildlife rescue and rehabilitation haven offering visitors educational guided walks to observe rescued elephants enjoying freedom.

taj_nature_walk.name: Taj Nature Walk
taj_nature_walk.description: Serene 70-hectare woodland reserve located 500 meters from the Taj East Gate, featuring 9 kilometers of nature trails, watchtowers, butterflies, and panoramic Taj views.

shah_jahan_park.name: Shah Jahan Park
shah_jahan_park.description: One of Agra's most sprawling and well-manicured civic gardens located midway between the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort, perfect for a peaceful afternoon respite.

paliwal_park.name: Paliwal Park (Hewitt Park)
paliwal_park.description: Historic 70-acre central public park featuring centuries-old shade trees, a scenic boating lake, morning jogging circuits, and the landmark John Public Library.
paliwal_park.best_time_to_visit: Morning exercise or leisurely evening boating

ram_bagh.name: Ram Bagh (Aram Bagh)
ram_bagh.description: The oldest surviving Mughal garden in India, originally laid out in 1528 by Emperor Babur on the Yamuna banks utilizing the Persian Charbagh concept.

buland_darwaza.name: Buland Darwaza
buland_darwaza.description: Towering 54-meter 'Gate of Magnificence' erected by Akbar in 1601 at Fatehpur Sikri to commemorate his triumphant conquest of Gujarat; the highest gateway in the world.
buland_darwaza.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon to capture golden sandstone hues

salim_chishti_tomb.name: Tomb of Sheikh Salim Chishti
salim_chishti_tomb.description: Masterpiece white marble mausoleum inside Fatehpur Sikri courtyard honoring the Sufi saint who prophesied the birth of Prince Salim (Jahangir); famous for wish threads tied on intricate stone jaalis.

panch_mahal_fatehpur.name: Panch Mahal, Fatehpur Sikri
panch_mahal_fatehpur.description: Extraordinary five-story columnar pleasure pavilion in Fatehpur Sikri tapering upward to a single domed chhatri, designed for imperial ladies to enjoy cooling breezes.

diwan_i_khas_agra_fort.name: Diwan-i-Khas, Agra Fort
diwan_i_khas_agra_fort.description: Hall of Private Audiences built by Shah Jahan in 1635 with elegant marble arches, delicate floral stone inlays, and the historic black onyx throne of Jahangir.

diwan_i_aam_agra_fort.name: Diwan-i-Aam, Agra Fort
diwan_i_aam_agra_fort.description: Majestic multi-columned Hall of Public Audience in Agra Fort where the Mughal emperor addressed the common populace and once displayed the famed Peacock Throne.

sheesh_mahal_agra_fort.name: Sheesh Mahal, Agra Fort
sheesh_mahal_agra_fort.description: The sparkling 'Palace of Mirrors' within Agra Fort, fitted with thousands of convex mirror pieces imported from Aleppo (Syria) to illuminate royal dressing chambers.

musamman_burj.name: Musamman Burj
musamman_burj.description: Graceful octagonal marble tower in Agra Fort where Shah Jahan spent his final years of house arrest gazingly looking across the Yamuna toward the Taj Mahal.

jahangiri_mahal.name: Jahangiri Mahal
jahangiri_mahal.description: Principal red sandstone zenana palace built by Akbar for his Rajput wives, showcasing an extraordinary synthesis of Hindu architectural carvings and Islamic arches.

anguri_bagh.name: Anguri Bagh (Garden of Grapes)
anguri_bagh.description: Symmetrical Charbagh courtyard garden fronting Khas Mahal in Agra Fort, originally planted with grapevines and exotic flora for royal imperial ladies.

jodha_bai_palace.name: Jodha Bai's Palace, Fatehpur Sikri
jodha_bai_palace.description: The largest and most important palace in Fatehpur Sikri's imperial seraglio, intricately decorated with Gujarati Hindu motifs, jharokhas, and glazed azure tiles.

birbal_bhavan.name: Birbal's Palace (Birbal Bhavan)
birbal_bhavan.description: Delightfully carved two-story red sandstone mansion built for Akbar's wise minister and Navratna, Raja Birbal, featuring ornate brackets and double-domed ceilings.

fatehpur_sikri_jama_masjid.name: Jama Masjid, Fatehpur Sikri
fatehpur_sikri_jama_masjid.description: Grand 16th-century congregational mosque built by Akbar, among the largest mosques in India, anchoring the monumental central courtyard of Fatehpur Sikri.

hiran_minar_fatehpur.name: Hiran Minar, Fatehpur Sikri
hiran_minar_fatehpur.description: Curious circular 21-meter tower studded with hundreds of carved stone elephant tusks, originally serving as an imperial milepost and vantage point over the lake.

subhash_bazaar.name: Subhash Bazaar
subhash_bazaar.description: Buzzing historic city bazaar situated near Agra Fort, popular among locals and travelers for silk sarees, textile fabrics, and ethnic Indian attire.

st_george_cathedral_agra.name: St. George's Cathedral
st_george_cathedral_agra.description: Elegant 1828 Anglican church in Agra Cantonment designed by Col. J.T. Boileau, showcasing neoclassical spires, Ionic columns, and colonial memorials.

akbar_church.name: Akbar's Church
akbar_church.description: The first Catholic church in North India, commissioned in 1598 by Jesuit missionaries under a royal firman and land endowment granted by Emperor Akbar.

roman_catholic_cemetery.name: Roman Catholic Cemetery (Red Taj)
roman_catholic_cemetery.description: Oldest Christian burial ground in Northern India, noted for the striking red sandstone mausoleum of Dutch mercenary John William Hessing, nicknamed the 'Red Taj'.

babur_chauburji.name: Babur's Chauburji Pavilion
babur_chauburji.description: Historic four-towered riverfront pavilion in Ram Bagh complex where Emperor Babur was temporarily buried before his mortal remains were interred in Kabul.

zohra_bagh.name: Zohra Bagh
zohra_bagh.description: Tranquil riverfront charbagh garden believed to have been constructed by Babur for his daughter Zohra, positioned quietly along the eastern bank of the Yamuna.

korai_village.name: Korai Tribal Village
korai_village.description: Traditional hamlet of the Kalandar community near Fatehpur Sikri offering authentic glimpse into rural lifestyle, folk crafts, and grassroots heritage.
korai_village.best_time_to_visit: En route to or returning from Fatehpur Sikri

hathi_ghat.name: Hathi Ghat
hathi_ghat.description: Historic Yamuna river ghat near Agra Fort where royal elephants were bathed during Mughal rule; now a popular site for river views and evening prayer rituals.
hathi_ghat.best_time_to_visit: Sunset hour for serene river aarti

battis_khamba.name: Battis Khamba
battis_khamba.description: Monumental 32-pillared red sandstone pavilion near Sikandra dating from the Mughal era, noted for its symmetrical stone arches and octagonal plan.

chhatri_of_jaswant_singh.name: Jaswant Singh Ki Chhatri
chhatri_of_jaswant_singh.description: Sole surviving Rajput monument in Agra, a striking 17th-century domed cenotaph featuring intricate jaali latticework built for Maharaja Jaswant Singh of Marwar.
chhatri_of_jaswant_singh.best_time_to_visit: Morning light filtering through stone screens

barahkhamba_agra.name: Barahkhamba Tomb Structure
barahkhamba_agra.description: Historic twelve-pillared Mughal tomb pavilion situated off Bodla Road, presenting graceful classical Mughal post-and-lintel stonework.

sanjay_place_commercial_hub.name: Sanjay Place Commercial Hub
sanjay_place_commercial_hub.description: The modern central business district and lifestyle center of Agra, packed with bustling shopping complexes, bookshops, electronics showrooms, and top eateries.
sanjay_place_commercial_hub.best_time_to_visit: Evening for dining and modern retail
